pptx-craft v1.0.0

- Initial release of pptx-craft (formerly html2ppt), a rendering engine for generating high-quality, editable PowerPoint (.pptx) from structured data.
- Prioritizes precise, text-first multi-pass layout to eliminate overlaps, truncations, and ensure measured spacing (气口).
- Supports native template cloning: maps layouts directly into user-specified PPT templates, inheriting themes and footers automatically.
- Strictly data-model driven; does not accept HTML as input.
- Built-in QA iteration and validation: slides are generated only if all elements meet layout and spacing rules.
- Flexible to both generic and user-supplied templates, measuring usable areas automatically when needed.
